Below matrix has two sections. 
1. On the left side extraction of R0 material - numbers here represent density of specified material at given planet - useful for extraction (R0 -> P1) planets
2. On the right side extraction of two types of R0 needed for production of specific P2 - numbers here represent density of less dense out of the two R0 needed - that's useful for selecting planet for diret R0 -> P2 production
